confirmIdentityHelp: Confirm your password in the secure browser. When you return, unlock the app to continue reviewing this request.
identityConfirmed: Identity confirmed. Review the request and choose your decision.
confirmationAccountMismatch: Use the same business account that is signed in on this phone.
approvalListHelp: Review discount requests from your team. Decisions apply only to the exact bill reviewed here.
approvalsUnavailable: Requests could not be verified. Refresh to check your connection and current access.
noOpenDecisions: You’re up to date. No open requests need your attention.
approvedNotApplied: Your approval is recorded. The sale is not yet confirmed at the till.
applyingHelp: The till has started applying this decision. Its receipt is being checked; do not create a replacement request.
decisionSelfDenied: Another authorized person must review your request.
decisionLimitDenied: This discount exceeds your approval limit.
decisionConfirmationHelp: This decision is for the reviewed bill. If the bill changes or the request expires, the till must send a new request.
decisionReasonRequired: Tell the team why you are declining.
decisionReasonOptional: Add a note for the team (optional).
decisionUncertain: The response was interrupted. Your decision may have been recorded. Refresh its status or safely retry the same decision.
decisionChangedHelp: This request has changed, expired or is outside your approval limit. Refresh to review its current status.
welcomeDetail: See the day clearly. Make the decisions that matter.
sampleHelp: No real account, sales or approval service is connected.
refreshed: Checked sample data. No new changes.
swipeHint: Swipe between items, or use Previous and Next.
notificationPlan: Scheduled summaries and stock alerts are planned. Delivery is not connected in this foundation.
approvalPlan: Approval workflows are planned. No decision can be submitted from this sample.
languagePlan: Choose your app language. All 18 language packs are available in this development build; translations are still under review.
languageSaveFailed: The language changed for this session, but could not be remembered. Please choose it again next time.
desktop: Long reports and detailed management belong in the desktop app.
noAccessHelp: Ask your administrator for access. No business data is loaded.
itemRanking: Ranked by net sales for the selected branches
stockEmpty: No stock alerts in this scope.
noInsight: No insights are available with this access.
invalidServer: Use a secure HTTPS server origin without a path or credentials.
serverCompatible: This server supports the Business connection protocol. Continue below to sign in.
serverUnsupported: This server does not yet support Posnic Business. Check with your administrator or try again after the Business server update.
serverTimeout: The server took too long to respond. Check your connection and try again.
serverBusy: The server is busy. Please try again shortly.
serverInvalidResponse: The server returned an unexpected response. Check the address with your administrator.
serverUnreachable: Unable to check this server. Check your connection and server address, then try again.
browserSignInHelp: Sign in on your server’s secure page. Your account password is never saved in this app.
authorizationFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Start again to get a new request.
matchingCode: Match this code on the sign-in page
waitingApproval: Waiting for your approval. Return here when you finish in the browser.
createPinHelp: Choose 4 or 6 digits to unlock Business on this phone. Avoid repeated or sequential numbers.
unlockHelp: Enter your app PIN. After five incorrect attempts, sign in again.
pinMismatch: The PINs do not match. Please enter them again.
pinWeak: Choose a less predictable 4- or 6-digit PIN.
pinLocked: The app was locked. Please unlock again.
signInRequired: Please sign in again to continue.
storageUnavailable: Secure storage is unavailable. Please try again on your phone.
accountUnavailable: Unable to verify this account. Check your connection or sign in again.
liveReportsPending: Live summaries are not available on this server yet. No sample figures are shown for your account.
privacyCover: Your business information is hidden while the app is inactive.
connectedDevicesHelp: Active Business sessions for your account. Remove a device you no longer use. Up to 100 recent sessions are shown.
devicesUnavailable: Unable to refresh connected devices. Check your connection and try again.
removeDeviceHelp: This device will need to sign in again. Its current server access will end.
biometricHelp: Use this phone’s Face ID or fingerprint instead of typing your Business PIN. Your PIN remains available. If enrolled biometrics change, enable this again after PIN unlock.
biometricUnavailable: Biometric unlock could not finish. Use your Business PIN or try again.
preparedSummaryTime: {date} · prepared at {time} in the branch’s timezone
summaryPartial: Some sales may still be syncing
summaryCompleteness: Includes sales received by your server. Offline tills may have newer sales. Refresh to check again.
salesDefinition: Discounts and rounding are already included. Returns are counted on the day they happen, even for older bills. Partly paid bills count at their billed value. This is sales, not cash collected or profit.
selectComparableBranch: Select one branch to see Today. These branches use different currencies or timezones, so their totals are shown separately.
summaryPreparing: Sales are not available yet. Refresh shortly. No amount is shown until the figures are verified.
summaryUnavailable: Could not verify this summary. Check your connection and refresh. No saved figures are shown for this request.
publisherHelp: Choose the desktop that prepares this branch’s mobile summaries. Keep it online with all tills synchronized. This setting belongs to this branch.
publisherConfirmHelp: Use {name} for this branch? The previous desktop will stop publishing. Totals will be unavailable until the new desktop prepares its first summary.
publisherChanged: Reporting desktop updated. Refresh Today after the new summary is prepared.
publisherUnavailable: Could not confirm the desktop setting. Refresh the list before trying again; another owner may have changed it.
publisherNoCandidates: No eligible desktop has connected recently. Open Today, keep the updated desktop and sync agent running, then refresh this list.
localSignOutOnly: Signed out on this phone. The server could not be reached to revoke the session; remove this device from a connected Business session.
notificationSettingsUnavailable: Could not confirm these settings. Refresh before trying again; they may have changed on another device.
inboxDeliveryHelp: Daily summaries are saved in your Business Inbox, even while the app is closed. Phone alerts are optional and require a supported device and server.
quietHoursHelp: Summaries scheduled during quiet hours wait until they end. All times follow the branch timezone, including daylight-saving changes.
inboxUnavailable: Could not confirm your Inbox. Check your connection and try again.
inboxHistoryHelp: Saved updates and active approval requests. Details reflect data available when each update was saved.
digestPartial: Sales after returns include tax and exclude tips. This saved summary may be incomplete; it is not a final settlement.
digestUnavailable: A verified summary was unavailable at the scheduled time. Open Today to check again. No amount has been assumed.
pushPrivacyHelp: Alerts only say an update is ready. Unlock Business to read it. Your sales figures and approval decisions stay off the lock screen.
pushServerUnavailable: Phone delivery is not configured for this app and server. Your Business Inbox is still available.
pushPermissionDenied: Notifications are disabled in your phone settings. You can enable them there, then refresh. Your Inbox remains available.
pushUnavailable: Could not confirm phone notification settings. Check your connection and refresh before trying again.
publisherMenuHelp: Choose the desktop that prepares branch totals
deviceMenuHelp: Review access and remove old devices
discardChangesHelp: Your schedule has unsaved changes. Keep editing or discard them before leaving.
summaryConnectionLost: Could not refresh. Check your connection and try again.
summaryRefreshing: Refreshing… Showing the last received summary until the check completes.
summaryLastKnown: Could not refresh. These are the last received figures, not a live update. They will be hidden after 15 minutes without a successful check.
itemRankingDefinition: Up to 20 items, ranked by allocated sales after returns. Bill discounts and rounding are shared across items. This is not profit.
itemHistoryIncomplete: Item history is incomplete. The ranking is unavailable until original sale details can be verified.
itemRankingEmpty: No item sales or returns were recorded for this day.
approvalAlertsHelp: Get new requests you can review in Inbox. Enable phone notifications for alerts on this device.
approvalAlertsQuietHelp: Phone alerts wait until quiet hours end. Expired requests are not sent.
approvalAlertsUnsupported: This server does not yet support approval alerts.
registerCloseHelp: A summary for each register session, after sync and preparation. This is not a whole-business closing report.
registerUnavailable: Session totals are unavailable. No amount has been assumed.
stockObservationHelp: Stored quantities from your desktop. Coverage is incomplete; stock may have changed.
stockNoKnownLow: No low-stock items in the checked data. Unavailable items may still need attention.
stockNegative: Stock is below zero. Check the stock records on your desktop.
stockAlertsHelp: Group low-stock alerts for this branch. Turn on phone notifications to receive them on this device.
stockAlertsUnsupported: This server does not yet support stock-alert settings.
stockAlertsQuietHelp: Alerts wait until quiet hours end. Stock is checked again before delivery.
salesCheckedTime: {date} · checked at {time} in the branch’s timezone
